name: span-waterfall
title: SpanWaterfall
description: Trace waterfall: a nice-interval (1/2/5×10ⁿ) time axis over percentage-positioned, row-packed span bars, a hover-needle reading the absolute wall-clock time under the pointer, a ∑ rollup-cost badge on parent rows, and dashed 'unbounded' bars for in-flight / clock-skewed spans. Controlled selection.
